<thought>Based on the observed isotopic pattern—dominant M peak at m/z 268.19, a significant M+1 peak (~20 % of base), and rapidly decreasing higher isotopic peaks—the pattern matches the expected distribution from many carbon atoms (13C ≈1.1 % per C). No other element shows a characteristic isotopic signature (e.g., Cl, Br, S) in the intensities. Therefore, carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified from the isotope distribution.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
